gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-gidole: Wobbly and playful, Jelly Crazies lets its bowls nearly seal shut and never thins a stroke. Gidole takes over below with open terminals like scissor blades, so a long page slows to a leisurely walk without feeling cramped.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-golos-text: Jelly Crazies wobbles with no thinning in its strokes at all. Golos Text sits underneath with a tall x-height and a widely parted s, so the display letters get room to be silly while the sans-serif text stays open.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hedvig-lette: Playful to the core, Jelly Crazies is happiest as a loud, wobbling heading with no thick-to-thin shifts. Hedvig Letters Sans does the quieter job, with small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals and a clear gap where each c ends.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-heebo: Heebo reads tall and plain, its curves stopping short instead of closing. Jelly Crazies is the one for big wobbly moments with bowls nearly sealed, while the plain sans handles the steady, everyday sentences.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hind-guntur: Rubbery meets stamped metal. Jelly Crazies is best at goofy, nearly closed shapes, and Hind Guntur counters with tall lowercase, wide curve gaps and a cable-like line that keeps the sans text easy to follow.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hind-madurai: Bouncy up top, ribbon-cut below. Hind Madurai gives the wobbly, nearly sealed bowls of Jelly Crazies a counterpart whose sans-serif lowercase fills the line and whose s curves open wide at both ends.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hind-mysuru: Jelly Crazies is all wobble, with bowls that nearly seal shut and no thinning anywhere. Hind Mysuru backs it up with lowercase pressing close to ascender height and an a with its mouth left ajar, a sans-serif that stays open.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hind-siligur: Hind Siliguri reads as a flat gray hum, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. Hind Siliguri keeps a long page moving smoothly in sans, while the wobbly Jelly Crazies is left to play elsewhere.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hind-vadodar: Hind Vadodara reads open and professional, with spacious gaps in its rounds and tall-bowled e and a shapes. Jelly Crazies earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-huninn: Wobbling bowls that nearly seal shut define Jelly Crazies, which never thins a stroke. Huninn does the opposite job, with s terminals clear of the body and lowercase rising close to cap height in a sans-serif.
